_status: In production use since 2026-10. Every check below reads from a verified endpoint. Add checks here, never in renderer code — a check added in a renderer is invisible to the workbook and the exports.

checks.recommended: At least one per physical site
checks.impact: E911 dispatch may route incorrectly; regulatory exposure (RAY BAUM'S Act).
checks.remediation: Define emergency locations per site and assign them to devices.

checks.impact: Emergency calls from that device cannot be located.
checks.remediation: Assign an emergency address to each hard phone.

checks.impact: Calls into an empty queue are abandoned or misrouted.
checks.remediation: Assign members or retire the queue.

checks.impact: After-hours calls follow the wrong rule set.
checks.remediation: Set business hours and review after-hours answering rules.

checks.recommended: No NotActivated extensions older than 30 days
checks.impact: Paid-for seats sitting unused; inflated licence count.
Configuration drift and unclear licence position.

checks.recommended: Explicitly configured and consistent with policy
checks.impact: Compliance gap, or recordings captured without a defined retention posture.
checks.remediation: Set automatic/on-demand recording per policy and confirm retention.

checks.impact: Routing, emergency addressing, and reporting all inherit site structure.

checks.recommended: Every active gate has at least one agent with access
checks.impact: Calls entering an unstaffed queue cannot be answered.
checks.remediation: Grant agent gate access, or deactivate the gate.

checks.impact: Inactive agents inflate seat counts and confuse routing design.
Locally-managed agents drift from the RingEX directory and bypass joiner/leaver processes.

checks.recommended: At least one DNC list where outbound dialing is in use
checks.impact: Outbound campaigns without a DNC list are a compliance exposure.
checks.remediation: Create and attach a DNC list.

checks.recommended: Every dial group has at least one campaign
checks.impact: An empty dial group is dead configuration that misleads routing design.
checks.remediation: Attach a campaign or remove the dial group.
